bio.text: Sanford Bishop has represented Georgia's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House since 1993 and has served on the Appropriations Committee since 2003.
He served in the Georgia House of Representatives from 1977 to 1990 and in the Georgia Senate in 1991-1992.
He was born in Mobile, Alabama, in 1947, and graduated from Morehouse College in 1968 and Emory University Law School in 1971.
